name: WorldVQA
intro: WorldVQA 是一个用于评估多模态大模型原子级视觉世界知识的基准，强调将视觉知识记忆与推理能力解耦，专门衡量模型对视觉实体的识别、命名和事实性掌握能力。
build_method: 专家标注, 双重验证
eval_feature: 事实性, 长尾分布, 双重验证
intro_en: WorldVQA is a benchmark for evaluating atomic visual world knowledge in multimodal large language models. It explicitly decouples knowledge memorization from reasoning and measures recognition, naming, and factual grounding for visual entities.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with WorldVQA arXiv:2602.02537v1, Sections 2.1-2.6, Table 2, Section 3.1, Table 3, and Appendix A; official project https://worldvqa2026.github.io/WorldVQA/, repository https://github.com/MoonshotAI/WorldVQA/, and dataset https://huggingface.co/datasets/moonshotai/WorldVQA. Version pin: 3,500 pairs and nine categories.. Ten expert annotators build atomic visual-knowledge items under isolation, coverage, granularity, and visual-reliability gates. For global expansion, regional labeling identifies underrepresented regions, GPT/Kimi association search proposes candidates, and human annotators curate the final additions. ISC deduplication against LAION/Common Crawl, five-model difficulty stratification, mandatory secondary review for Hard items, and parallel Gemini-3-Pro plus blind-human verification follow. The final 3,500 pairs are judged with GPT-oss-120b and reported with accuracy, attempt rate, CGA, and F-score; People is excluded from the eight-category overall.
